stem: On the bell curve of developmental and cognitive abilities, what statistical threshold defines a developmental delay or intellectual disability?

options.text: Falling more than $1$ standard deviation below the mean.
Falling below $2$ standard deviations below the mean ($< 2$nd percentile).
Falling within the middle $95$ percent of the curve.

explanation: The source defines these conditions as occurring when scores fall below $2$ standard deviations below the mean or less than the $2$nd percentile.
rationale: Think about the specific distance from the average on the bell curve that marks a significant impairment.

optionExplanations.A: While the $5$th percentile is low, the specific clinical threshold mentioned is more stringent.
optionExplanations.B: One standard deviation covers a large portion of the population; the clinical definition requires a more significant discrepancy.
optionExplanations.C: The source defines these conditions as occurring when scores fall below $2$ standard deviations below the mean or less than the $2$nd percentile.
optionExplanations.D: The middle $95$ percent represents the typical range of development and cognitive abilities.
